description: A WHAT-IF for a candidate week or multi-week plan: its effect on Fitness (CTL), Fatigue (ATL) and Form (TSB) day by day before the user commits. READ-ONLY, keeps no state. `sessions`: [{ date, tss?, title?, guide? }], each after `asOf` (default today; at most 120 days ahead); several on a date add up. TSS is the given `tss`, else the median of the user's own sessions with the same title (or guide.title) in the last 90 days (2+ needed); with no estimate the call is REFUSED and asks for `tss` (never a guess). propose_next_week's `sessions` fit as they are. Optional `goalDate` (TSB that day vs the fresh band 5-25) and `compare` (a second plan over the same days). Same model as forecast_training_load (CTL can be about 1 point off the watch). risks: a day with TSB below -30, or a full week whose CTL rises by over 8 or whose TSS is over 30% above the previous 28-day average (heuristics with contested evidence, not safe/unsafe lines). personalResponse is the user's OWN history (next-night HRV and recovery after high-load days vs others, by get_tag_effects' rule, 15+ nights each; else 'insufficient') and responseToPlan claims a shift ONLY where history differed beyond noise: an association, not a cause. EVERY number is MODEL-BASED, never a prediction of how the user will feel. An unreadable section is named in errors instead of failing the call.

asOf.description: Last day counted as done (default today). The simulation starts the day after.

compare.description: Optional second candidate plan over the same days.

goalDate.description: Optional race or test day, YYYY-MM-DD, after asOf: the result gives TSB that day.

sessions.description: The candidate plan, one entry per session.

guide.description: Optional strength guide spec; its `title` feeds the TSS estimate, its `date` must equal the session's.

title.description: e.g. 'PUSH A': TSS is estimated from the user's sessions of that title when `tss` is missing.

tss.description: Training stress in get_training_load's unit (easy hour about 40-60, hard 80-100+). Overrides any estimate.

name: simulate_plan
title: Simulate a candidate plan: CTL/ATL/TSB, ramp, risk days, your own response (read-only, model-based)
